Old Abandoned Settlements attribution
=====================================

The Lost City building artwork, building prototype foundations, and settlement
layout templates are adapted from "Old Abandoned Settlements" by SacredAnarchy:

https://mods.factorio.com/mod/OldAbandonedSettlements

The assets are bundled in The Cave with explicit permission from SacredAnarchy,
as confirmed by The Cave project owner. The imported prototypes and templates
were renamed, isolated to Lost City surfaces, and modified for scripted mission
use. SacredAnarchy does not endorse or support The Cave.

The original Independent Project Licence is included beside this notice as
OldAbandonedSettlements-LICENCE.txt.
